headline: DET @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is DET 4.63 at CLE 2.83, with a projected total of 7.46. The projected total climbed +0.53, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Tarik Skubal has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Gleyber Torres, José Ramírez, Riley Greene, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jahmai Jones, Matt Vierling because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
